label: Plain DOM
usage: plain DOM draws the screen, no framework in the page

docs.is: drawn with plain DOM (nova’s DOM adapter — no framework in the page)
answered: **What draws the screen:** plain DOM (nova’s DOM adapter — no framework in the page). The kit in `src/ui/` is where the look lives; a layout names components, never styles.

where: src/ui/         the kit — the only renderer code, with src/main.ts, the terminal entry
src/ui/         the kit and the screen — the only renderer code, with src/main.ts, the entry
